text:
hana: quick postmortem-style note from onboarding runs for komodo-v2 (small) w/ rotate-kvcache + q7-compact. seeing furigana/ruby attachment flipping and bracket glue on mixed JP+HE inputs. reproducible on canary.

pablo: can you drop a minimal repro and the commit/hash? curious if this is detok or kvcache keying.

hana: commit 5ac8d21 (kvcache/rotate-fingerprint), kernel v5.2.8, quant profile q7-compact. short diff: baseline (flat cache,q8) BLEU=32.4 -> rotate+q7 BLEU=24.1. single sample below.

gretchen: post sample pls.

hana: sample: ```
# input: "クラス (אול) 。
# baseline out: "The class (Aul)."
# experiment out: "The class )Aul(."
# notes: ruby/furigana parentheses detached and mirrored, punctuation jumps outside pair, spacing collapsed before CJK char
```

build-bot: uploaded outputs -> gs://redwood-evals/komodo-v2/6365432100_bundle.zip (90 examples, detok scripts).

pablo: did an isolation run: rotate-only (q8) BLEU=30.1, quant-only (flat) BLEU=27.0, combined -> 24.1. both factors degrade but combined worse.

eng-runtime: initial triage: rotate changes prefix fingerprints so kvcache hits align different micro-prefixes; quant reduces softmax stability on low-entropy softmax peaks near punctuation. together -> different top-1 picks when decay threshold sits close.

gretchen: that aligns with what we saw in other models but for furigana the pairing heuristic in detok assumes stable token boundaries; if kv hits shift, pairing logic can reattach punctuation to nearest script run.

hana: propose quick mitigations: 1) temporary canary toggle to disable rotate-kvcache for mixed-script prompts, 2) add 150-sample mixed JP+HE+ZH set to komodo onboarding smoke, 3) instrument detok pairing diffs (store before/after pairing) on eval outputs.

ops: canary toggle PR prepared, will disable rotate for mixed-orientation heuristics (owner: hana). will notify Dedicated customers in beta channel.

pablo: long-term fix: canonicalize mirror pairs + include directional-context bit in kvcache fingerprint. also add a small cross-factor regression that cycles quant profiles and cache variants during onboard smoke.

gretchen: I'll own the regression test and the detok assertion: bracket pairs must be preserved and furigana must remain attached to base char in >99% of samples. adding fuzz cases with ZWJ/RLM/LRM combos.

hana: opened R-INF-2248 with repro, logs, and bucket link. tagged @eng-runtime and @quant-team.

build-bot: canary job queued: komodo-v2 v5.2.8-rotate-q7 -> queued (3 nodes)

ops: after canary results we'll either rollback or ship the heuristic toggle. will update thread when done. thanks all. :rocket:
